objective: The Traveler and NØVA bring the newly-formed Opsly blueprint (Episode 5) to its first real tenant-world: Peskids — water, children, swimming, real families. It stops being architecture and becomes something with people depending on it. NØVA meets Wavo for the first time, uniting the two franchises on-screen for the first time.

scenes.description: The empty blueprint gets its first world
scenes.visuals: The layered structure from Episode 5 glows brighter as a new shape attaches to it — an island full of water forming at its base
scenes.copy: El blueprint, por fin, tuvo su primer mundo.

scenes.visuals: The Traveler and NØVA stepping onto a glowing blue-crystal pool complex, water everywhere, small figures of children and companion robots visible swimming
scenes.copy: Peskids. Una academia de natación. Familias. Clases. Seguimientos.

scenes.visuals: NØVA approaches a companion robot at the pool's edge — Wavo. The two robots regard each other, curious
The Traveler looking at a simple operational display — who to call, who hasn't been served, today's class, who needs follow-up
scenes.copy: Ya no bastaba con arquitectura. Alguien necesitaba saber a quién llamar. Quién no había sido atendido. Qué clase había hoy.

scenes.description: Closing — the lesson NØVA and Wavo land on together
scenes.visuals: NØVA and Wavo side by side at the pool's edge, The Traveler watching from behind
scenes.copy: La tecnología solo importa si mejora una experiencia humana real.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: NØVA and Wavo side by side at a glowing pool edge, The Traveler watching from the water's edge

notes: Act VI of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.
Theme: the first real tenant/client as a whole living world, not just a project — the blueprint from Episode 5 gets its first population.

Emotional conflict: The Traveler realizing this world depends on him getting it right for real children/families, not an abstraction; the platform has to work in practice — an admin needs to know who to call, who hasn't been served, what class is today, who needs follow-up.
Visual motif: water as a recurring symbol-bearing surface (see ../../canon/SYMBOLS.md). Peskids appears as an island full of water within the Parallel World.
Crossover rule: see ../../canon/WAVO.md — NØVA represents imagination, Wavo represents applied learning; together they land on: technology only matters if it improves a real human experience.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 06.
